notes: 'as with' read as one rendering of `כְּ` under rule 30; the materially different alternatives — marking 'with' `added`, or reading it as a second distributed occurrence of the `בְּ` under rule 25 — are named in the unit note.
The assimilated article token behind the pointed `כַּ` is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing 'a bird' (rules 12, 29).
